body:
Thanks again for a fantastic tool!

I use a relatively new lens which has no lensfun database entry (Sigma 20-200mm), but there is an Adobe lcp, which I can assign to for lens correction. Is the any way to automatically use the lens info (20-200mm F3.5/6.3 DG | Contemporary 025) to select the corresponding LCP file? Even if a cross-reference file (20-200mm... ==> SIGMA .....lcp) in .local to serve as an alias would be most useful, for this and for other lenses facing this problem.
title: Automatic selection or cross-refernce of lcp for lens correction?
